messages:
alex: Alert from SRE metrics — p99 DB connection count jumped ~3x in eu-west1 at 09:18 UTC after the canary. Apps are seeing `too many connections`. Need a hotpatch. Any objections to temporarily pinning runtime -> v1.23.3 and reverting the ephemeral credential change? cc @maria @jamal

ops-bot: [ALERT] prod.eu-west1-db: connection_count p99 = 312 (baseline 96). Recent deployment: runtime v1.24.0-canary by @maria (ts 2245677000).

maria: I rolled the credential rotation experiment in canary — I can roll it back now. Reverting will require a config rollback + rolling restart of service-a, ~3-5min window. I'll try canary-only rollback first to confirm.

jamal: If we rollback creds we should also pin to last stable runtime. Proposed plan: 1) set config `auth.use_ephemeral=false` 2) pin runtime via deploy-bot to v1.23.3 for eu-west1 3) monitor 10m then promote. Note: deploy-bot needs 2 approvers for a regional pin.

sre-lead: Approve for emergency window. Conditions: keep canary at 1% until metrics stable; if error_rate > 0.5% after 10m -> full rollback. Also ensure smoke tests pass post-roll. :thumbsup:

emma: Who's running the deploy? @maria can you paste the exact `deploy-bot` command and the config change you'll run? Also add a one-line release-note for the postmortem.

maria: Deploy-bot command below. Running after approvals.
```
/deploy-bot pin runtime=v1.23.3 region=eu-west1 scope=service-a -m "hotfix: revert ephemeral creds"
```
I'll also flip `auth.use_ephemeral=false` via config service: 
```
/config set service-a auth.use_ephemeral false --env=prod --region=eu-west1
```
I'll run canary rollback first and then pin if canary stabilizes.

ops-bot: Approval required from 2 approvers. Current required approvers: jamal, sre-lead.

jamal: Approve. running pre-checks now (conn pool sizes, replica lag).

sre-lead: Approve. Pre-checks look good. Go for deploy.

deploy-bot: Starting job 66721. Steps: lock, apply-config, pin-runtime, rolling-restart (max 2 pods simultaneously), smoke-tests, release-note-chk. ETA ~6m. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/66721

alex: ✅ staying on the loop. Watching metrics and will post final status here.

ops-bot: Job 66721 succeeded. p50/p95/p99 connections returned to baseline within 4m after pin + config change. Incident state: mitigated. Please file postmortem branch: `pm/2245678901-db-cred-rollback`"
